svg.title: Fork vs upstream CodeGraph: every result
svg.desc: Heatmap of the fork's change against upstream for full index time, peak memory and one-file sync on seven repositories, the MCP server on n8n and gin, and command-line startup. Of 76 comparisons it is better in 60, about the same in 4 and worse in 12.
svg.text: Each cell is the fork’s change versus upstream. Negative is better (less time or memory). Green = better by over 3%, amber = about the same, red = worse.
Measured 2026-10-13 · upstream 34dd3d2f vs fork f045e5f7 · Node 24.21.0, Bun 1.4.3 · 16-vCPU WSL2 · two runs per arm, median · fork on Node unless noted
